summary: Completed frontend e2e validation of login, overview, employee directory CRUD, reports upload, and mobile layout.
action_items: Consider wiring report tag filter buttons; they currently render as controls without filtering behavior.
critical_code_review_comments: Employee and report data are intentionally local in-memory demo state; refresh/logout loses mutations and no Supabase/backend persistence is wired (as requested for UI-only scope).
Report tag buttons have no onClick/state and therefore are non-functional despite appearing interactive.
seed_data_creation: Created one temporary employee and one temporary report in client-side state during the test; both existed only for the session.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested UI flows passed on the public preview at desktop and mobile widths. Tag filtering and mobile menu behavior were not part of the requested checklist and remain unimplemented/unverified.
rca of the issue: Report tag buttons are mapped from labels but lack state and click handlers in Reports, so they cannot change the displayed report list. This is a UI-only implementation gap, not an API failure.
